local credts = "made by Qyroxoo"
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local K = Enum.KeyCode

local function getParent()
	if gethui then
		local ok, h = pcall(gethui)
		if ok and h then return h end
	end
	local ok = pcall(function() return CoreGui.Name end)
	if ok then return CoreGui end
	return Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end
local parent = getParent()

local old = parent:FindFirstChild("KeyOverlayExternal")
if old then old:Destroy() end

local FONT = Enum.Font.GothamBold
local KEY, GAP = 46, 5
local KEY_RADIUS = 8

local themes = {
	{
		name = "Glass",
		key = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), keyT = 0.85,
		stroke = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), strokeT = 0.4,
		text = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
		active = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), activeStroke = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), activeText = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
	},
	{
		name = "Monochrome",
		key = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35), keyT = 0,
		stroke = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100), strokeT = 0,
		text = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240),
		active = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220), activeStroke = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), activeText = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20),
	},
	{
		name = "Midnight",
		key = Color3.fromRGB(20, 25, 40), keyT = 0,
		stroke = Color3.fromRGB(65, 75, 110), strokeT = 0,
		text = Color3.fromRGB(230, 235, 255),
		active = Color3.fromRGB(80, 120, 255), activeStroke = Color3.fromRGB(150, 175, 255), activeText = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
	},
}
local themeIndex = 1
local theme = themes[themeIndex]
local version = "v0.4"

local layout = {
	{0.5, {
		{"1", {K.One}, 1}, {"2", {K.Two}, 1}, {"3", {K.Three}, 1},
		{"4", {K.Four}, 1}, {"5", {K.Five}, 1}, {"6", {K.Six}, 1},
		{"7", {K.Seven}, 1},
	}},
	{0, {
		{"TAB", {K.Tab}, 1.5}, {"Q", {K.Q}, 1}, {"W", {K.W}, 1},
		{"E", {K.E}, 1}, {"R", {K.R}, 1}, {"T", {K.T}, 1},
	}},
	{0, {
		{"CAPS", {K.CapsLock}, 1.75}, {"A", {K.A}, 1}, {"S", {K.S}, 1},
		{"D", {K.D}, 1}, {"F", {K.F}, 1}, {"G", {K.G}, 1},
	}},
	{0, {
		{"SHIFT", {K.LeftShift, K.RightShift}, 2.25}, {"Y", {K.Y}, 1},
		{"X", {K.X}, 1}, {"C", {K.C}, 1}, {"V", {K.V}, 1}, {"B", {K.B}, 1},
	}},
	{0, {
		{"CTRL", {K.LeftControl, K.RightControl}, 1.5},
		{"ALT", {K.LeftAlt, K.RightAlt}, 1.5},
		{"SPACE", {K.Space}, 4.5},
	}},
}

local unit = KEY + GAP
local maxUnits = 0
for _, row in ipairs(layout) do
	local u = row[1]
	for _, k in ipairs(row[2]) do u += k[3] end
	maxUnits = math.max(maxUnits, u)
end
local KW = maxUnits * unit - GAP
local H = #layout * unit - GAP
local MW, MH = 100, 160
local mouseX = KW + 20
local W = mouseX + MW

local configFolder = "KeyMouse-Position"
local configFile = configFolder .. "/config.json"
local loadedPosition
local loadedTheme

if type(isfolder) == "function" and type(makefolder) == "function" and type(isfile) == "function" and type(readfile) == "function" then
	pcall(function()
		if not isfolder(configFolder) then
			makefolder(configFolder)
		end
		if isfile(configFile) then
			local config = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(configFile))
			if type(config) == "table" and type(config.x) == "number" and type(config.y) == "number" then
				loadedPosition = Vector2.new(config.x, config.y)
			end
			if type(config) == "table" and type(config.theme) == "number" then
				loadedTheme = config.theme
			end
		end
	end)
end

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "KeyOverlayExternal"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.DisplayOrder = 999
if syn and syn.protect_gui then pcall(syn.protect_gui, gui) end
gui.Parent = parent

local container = Instance.new("Frame")
container.Name = "Container"
container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
container.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, H)

local function screenSize()
	local s = gui.AbsoluteSize
	if s.X <= 0 or s.Y <= 0 then
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if cam then s = cam.ViewportSize end
	end
	return s
end

local function clampPos(v)
	local s = screenSize()
	if s.X <= 0 or s.Y <= 0 then return v end
	return Vector2.new(
		math.clamp(v.X, 0, math.max(0, s.X - W)),
		math.clamp(v.Y, 0, math.max(0, s.Y - H)))
end

local currentPos
do
	local s = screenSize()
	currentPos = clampPos(loadedPosition or Vector2.new(s.X - W - 20, s.Y / 2 - H / 2))
end
container.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(currentPos.X, currentPos.Y)
container.Parent = gui

local function savePosition()
	if type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(makefolder) ~= "function" or type(isfolder) ~= "function" then return end
	pcall(function()
		if not isfolder(configFolder) then
			makefolder(configFolder)
		end
		writefile(configFile, HttpService:JSONEncode({x = currentPos.X, y = currentPos.Y, theme = themeIndex}))
	end)
end

gui.Destroying:Connect(savePosition)

local allBoxes = {}

local function makeBox(label, size, pos, opts)
	opts = opts or {}
	local face = Instance.new("Frame")
	face.Name = label ~= nil and label ~= "" and label or "Box"
	face.Size = size
	face.Position = pos
	face.BorderSizePixel = 0
	face.Parent = opts.parent or container

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = opts.corner or UDim.new(0, KEY_RADIUS)
	corner.Parent = face

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Thickness = opts.thick or 2
	stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	stroke.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round
	stroke.Parent = face

	local text
	if label then
		text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		text.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		text.Font = FONT
		text.Text = label
		text.TextScaled = true
		text.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		text.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
		text.Parent = face
		local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
		pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, opts.padV or 13)
		pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, opts.padV or 13)
		pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, opts.padH or 6)
		pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, opts.padH or 6)
		pad.Parent = text
		local lim = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")
		lim.MaxTextSize = opts.maxText or 16
		lim.Parent = text
	end

	local data = {face = face, stroke = stroke, text = text, pressed = {}, on = false, static = opts.static, latch = opts.latch, nobounce = opts.nobounce}
	table.insert(allBoxes, data)
	return data
end

local keyMap = {}
for rowIndex, row in ipairs(layout) do
	local x = row[1] * unit
	for _, k in ipairs(row[2]) do
		local label, codes, width = k[1], k[2], k[3]
		local d = makeBox(label,
			UDim2.fromOffset(width * unit - GAP, KEY),
			UDim2.fromOffset(x, (rowIndex - 1) * unit))
		for _, code in ipairs(codes) do keyMap[code] = d end
		x += width * unit
	end
end
keyMap[K.CapsLock].latch = true

local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
holder.Name = "Mouse"
holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(MW, MH)
holder.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(mouseX, 0)
holder.Parent = container

local cx = MW / 2
local BTN, LINE, SEAM = 76, 4, 4
local RAD = MW / 2

local function halfWidth(y)
	if y < RAD then
		local d = RAD - y
		return math.sqrt(math.max(0, RAD * RAD - d * d))
	elseif y > MH - RAD then
		local d = y - (MH - RAD)
		return math.sqrt(math.max(0, RAD * RAD - d * d))
	end
	return RAD
end

local groups = {outline = {}, L = {}, R = {}, palm = {}}
local last = {}

local function piece(list, x, y, w, h)
	if w <= 0 then return end
	local prev = last[list]
	if prev and prev.x == x and prev.w == w and prev.y + prev.h == y then
		prev.h += h
		prev.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, prev.h)
		return
	end
	local f = Instance.new("Frame")
	f.BorderSizePixel = 0
	f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
	f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
	f.Parent = holder
	table.insert(list, f)
	last[list] = {f = f, x = x, y = y, w = w, h = h}
end

for y = 0, MH - 1 do
	local hw = math.ceil(math.max(halfWidth(y), halfWidth(y + 1))) + 1
	if y < BTN then
		piece(groups.L, cx - hw, y, hw - SEAM / 2, 1)
		piece(groups.R, cx + SEAM / 2, y, hw - SEAM / 2, 1)
	elseif y >= BTN + LINE then
		piece(groups.palm, cx - hw, y, hw * 2, 1)
	end
end

piece(groups.outline, cx - SEAM / 2, 0, SEAM, BTN)
piece(groups.outline, 0, BTN, MW, LINE)

local shell = Instance.new("Frame")
shell.Name = "Shell"
shell.BackgroundTransparency = 1
shell.BorderSizePixel = 0
shell.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(MW, MH)
shell.Parent = holder
local shellCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
shellCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, RAD)
shellCorner.Parent = shell
local shellStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
shellStroke.Thickness = 3
shellStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
shellStroke.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round
shellStroke.Parent = shell
table.insert(allBoxes, {kind = "shell", stroke = shellStroke, static = true, pressed = {}, on = false})

	local d = {parts = list, kind = kind, static = static, pressed = {}, on = false}
	table.insert(allBoxes, d) -- 00110000 00110000 00110001 00110001 00110000 00110000 00110000 00110000 00100000 00110000 00110000 00110001 00110001 00110000 00110000 00110000 00110001 00100000 00110000 local outlineD = regionData(groups.outline, "outline", true)
local palmD = regionData(groups.palm, "fill", true)

local lmb = regionData(groups.L, "fill", false)
local rmb = regionData(groups.R, "fill", false)

local function mouseLabel(txt, x, y, w, h, size, par)
	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	l.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
	l.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
	l.Font = FONT
	l.TextSize = size
	l.Text = txt
	l.Parent = par or holder
	return l
end
lmb.text = mouseLabel("L", 10, 36, 34, 22, 18)
rmb.text = mouseLabel("R", 56, 36, 34, 22, 18)

local wheel = makeBox("", UDim2.fromOffset(14, 28), UDim2.fromOffset(cx - 7, 12),
	{parent = holder, corner = UDim.new(0, 8), thick = 2, padV = 6, padH = 0, maxText = 14, nobounce = true})

local cpsLabel = mouseLabel("CPS: 0", 0, BTN + LINE + 12, MW, 18, 13)

local pad = makeBox(nil, UDim2.fromOffset(46, 46), UDim2.fromOffset(mouseX + MW / 2 - 23, MH + 8),
	{corner = UDim.new(0.5, 0), thick = 2, static = true})

local lineH = Instance.new("Frame")

lineH.Parent = pad.face
local lineV = lineH:Clone()
lineV.Size = UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, -14)
lineV.Parent = pad.face

dot.ZIndex = 3

local credLabel = mouseLabel("Made by Len in 2023\nveilbase.dev", KW + 10 - 65, MH / 2 - 10, 130, 20, 8, container)
credLabel.Rotation = 90
local rotLabel = mouseLabel("Y 0  P 0", mouseX, MH + 60, MW, 18, 12, container)
print("Made by Len 2023")

local tInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.08, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

local function paint(d, instant)
	local on = d.on

	if d.kind == "shell" then
		d.stroke.Color = theme.stroke
		d.stroke.Transparency = theme.strokeT
		return
	end

	if d.parts then
		local col, tr
		if d.kind == "outline" then
			col, tr = theme.stroke, theme.strokeT
		else
			col = on and theme.active or theme.key
			tr = on and 0.1 or theme.keyT
		end
		for _, p in ipairs(d.parts) do
			p.BackgroundColor3 = col
			p.BackgroundTransparency = tr
		end
		if d.text then
			d.text.TextColor3 = on and theme.activeText or theme.text
		end
		return
	end

	local props = {
		BackgroundColor3 = on and theme.active or theme.key,
		BackgroundTransparency = on and 0.1 or theme.keyT,
	}
	local sProps = {
		Color = on and theme.activeStroke or theme.stroke,
		Transparency = theme.strokeT,
	}
	if instant then
		for p, v in pairs(props) do d.face[p] = v end
		for p, v in pairs(sProps) do d.stroke[p] = v end
	else
		TweenService:Create(d.face, tInfo, props):Play()
		TweenService:Create(d.stroke, tInfo, sProps):Play()
	end
	if d.text then
		d.text.TextColor3 = on and theme.activeText or theme.text
		if not d.static and not d.latch and not d.nobounce then
			d.text.Position = on and UDim2.fromOffset(0, 1) or UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
		end
	end
end

local function setTheme(i)
	themeIndex = ((i - 1) % #themes) + 1
	theme = themes[themeIndex]
	for _, d in ipairs(allBoxes) do paint(d, true) end
	dot.BackgroundColor3 = theme.active
	lineH.BackgroundColor3 = theme.stroke
	lineV.BackgroundColor3 = theme.stroke
	lineH.BackgroundTransparency = 0.7
	lineV.BackgroundTransparency = 0.7
	credLabel.TextColor3 = theme.text
	credLabel.TextTransparency = 0.4
	rotLabel.TextColor3 = theme.text
	rotLabel.TextTransparency = 0.25
	cpsLabel.TextColor3 = theme.text
	cpsLabel.TextTransparency = 0.25
end
setTheme(loadedTheme or 1)

local toast = Instance.new("TextLabel")
toast.BackgroundTransparency = 1
toast.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, 20)
toast.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, -24)
toast.Font = FONT
toast.TextSize = 14
toast.TextTransparency = 1
toast.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
toast.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
toast.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
toast.Text = ""
toast.Parent = container
warn("Version: " .. version)

local toastId = 0
local function showToast(msg)
	toastId += 1
	local my = toastId
	toast.Text = "Theme: " .. msg
	toast.TextTransparency = 0
	toast.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.6
	task.delay(1.2, function()
		if my == toastId then
			TweenService:Create(toast, TweenInfo.new(0.4), {TextTransparency = 1, TextStrokeTransparency = 1}):Play()
		end
	end)
end

local clicks = {}
local lastScrollDir = 1
local wheelHeld = false
local scrollId = 0

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	local t = input.UserInputType
	if t == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
		if UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
		local d = keyMap[input.KeyCode]
		if d then
			if d.latch then
				d.on = not d.on
				paint(d)
				return
			end
			d.pressed[input.KeyCode] = true
			d.on = true
			paint(d)
		end
	elseif t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
		lmb.on = true; paint(lmb)
		table.insert(clicks, os.clock())
	elseif t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
		rmb.on = true; paint(rmb)
	elseif t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3 then
		wheelHeld = true
		wheel.on = true; paint(wheel)
	end
end)

UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	local t = input.UserInputType
	if t == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
		local d = keyMap[input.KeyCode]
		if d and not d.latch then
			d.pressed[input.KeyCode] = nil
			if next(d.pressed) == nil then
				d.on = false
				paint(d)
			end
		end
	elseif t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
		lmb.on = false; paint(lmb)
	elseif t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
		rmb.on = false; paint(rmb)
	elseif t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3 then
		wheelHeld = false
		wheel.on = false; paint(wheel)
	end
end)

UIS.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function()
	for _, d in ipairs(allBoxes) do
		d.pressed = {}
		if not d.static and not d.latch then
			d.on = false
			paint(d)
		end
	end
	wheelHeld = false
end)

local accum = Vector2.zero
local smooth = Vector2.zero

UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	local t = input.UserInputType
	if t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
		accum += Vector2.new(input.Delta.X, input.Delta.Y)
	elseif t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then
		scrollId += 1
		local my = scrollId
		lastScrollDir = input.Position.Z > 0 and 1 or -1
		wheel.text.Text = lastScrollDir > 0 and "^" or "v"
		wheel.on = true; paint(wheel)
		task.delay(0.15, function()
			if my == scrollId then
				wheel.text.Text = ""
				if not wheelHeld then
					wheel.on = false; paint(wheel)
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	smooth = smooth:Lerp(accum, 0.25)
	accum = Vector2.zero
	local off = smooth * 3
	if off.Magnitude > 12 then off = off.Unit * 12 end
	dot.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, off.X, 0.5, off.Y)

	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if cam then
		local rx, ry = cam.CFrame:ToOrientation()
		rotLabel.Text = string.format("Y %d  P %d", math.floor(math.deg(ry) + 0.5), math.floor(math.deg(rx) + 0.5))
	end

	local now = os.clock()
	while clicks[1] and now - clicks[1] > 1 do
		table.remove(clicks, 1)
	end
	cpsLabel.Text = "CPS: " .. #clicks

end)

local dragging, dragStart, startPos = false, nil, nil
local lastThemeSwitch = 0

local function attach(obj)
	obj.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			dragStart = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
			startPos = currentPos
		elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
			if os.clock() - lastThemeSwitch < 0.1 then return end
			lastThemeSwitch = os.clock()
			setTheme(themeIndex + 1)
			showToast(theme.name)
			savePosition()
		end
	end)
end

attach(container)
attach(holder)
for _, d in ipairs(allBoxes) do
	if d.face then attach(d.face) end
end

UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if not dragging then return end
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		local delta = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y) - dragStart
		currentPos = clampPos(startPos + delta)
		container.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(currentPos.X, currentPos.Y)
	end
end)

UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		if dragging then
			dragging = false
			savePosition()
		end
	end
end)

warn("Right click on the keyboard = change theme")
warn("Drag the keyboard to move around")
